This Diwali, HP celebrates the Lights of Change – the thoughtful innovations lighting up India and making lives brighter. From turning farm stubble into a resource to making healthcare more accessible, these stories show how one idea can solve a real problem and create an impact that reaches far beyond itself.
Watch these stories of dreamers and achievers who are making a difference, and discover the many ways innovation is shaping a brighter India.
